intro.quote: An authoritative name error. The NSEC3 RRs prove that the name does not exist and that there is no wildcard RR that should have been expanded.

steps.explain: The resolver queries for the A record at a.c.x.w.example.
The authoritative server returns NSEC3 records that prove the queried name does not exist and that no applicable wildcard exists.

intro.quote: A "no data" response. The NSEC3 RR proves that the name exists and that the requested RR type does not.

steps.explain: The resolver queries for the MX record at ns1.example.
The authoritative server returns an NSEC3 record that proves the queried name exists but does not contain the requested RR type.

intro.quote: The RDATA of the NSEC3 RR is as shown below:

fields.name: Hash Algorithm
fields.explain: Identifies the cryptographic hash algorithm used to construct the hash value.

cite.quote: The Hash Algorithm field identifies the cryptographic hash algorithm used to construct the hash-value.

fields.name: Flags
fields.explain: Carries processing flags. The only flag defined here is Opt-Out, and undefined flags must be zero.

cite.quote: The Flags field contains 8 one-bit flags that can be used to indicate different processing. All undefined flags must be zero. The only flag defined by this specification is the Opt-Out flag.

fields.name: Iterations
fields.explain: Sets how many additional times the hash function is performed. More iterations improve resistance to dictionary attacks but increase server and resolver work.

cite.quote: The Iterations field defines the number of additional times the hash function has been performed. More iterations result in greater resiliency of the hash value against dictionary attacks, but at a higher computational cost for both the server and resolver.

fields.name: Salt Length
fields.explain: Gives the length of the Salt field in octets.

cite.quote: The Salt Length field defines the length of the Salt field in octets, ranging in value from 0 to 255.

fields.name: Salt
fields.explain: Is appended to the original owner name before hashing to defend against pre-calculated dictionary attacks.

cite.quote: The Salt field is appended to the original owner name before hashing in order to defend against pre-calculated dictionary attacks.

fields.name: Hash Length
fields.explain: Gives the length of the Next Hashed Owner Name field in octets.

cite.quote: The Hash Length field defines the length of the Next Hashed Owner Name field, ranging in value from 1 to 255 octets.

fields.name: Next Hashed Owner Name
fields.explain: Identifies the next owner name in hash order.

cite.quote: The Next Hashed Owner Name field contains the next hashed owner name in hash order.

fields.name: Type Bit Maps
fields.explain: Identifies the RRSet types present at the original owner name of the NSEC3 record.

cite.quote: The Type Bit Maps field identifies the RRSet types that exist at the original owner name of the NSEC3 RR.

fields.name: Flags
fields.explain: The Opt-Out flag is unused. All flags must be zero, and an NSEC3PARAM record with another Flags value must be ignored.

cite.quote: The Opt-Out flag is not used and is set to zero. All other flags are reserved for future use, and must be zero. NSEC3PARAM RRs with a Flags field value other than zero MUST be ignored.
